description: Direct stop ordering by DeepSeek and Opus, scored with the official rc-cli scorer

metric.name: Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge score
metric.formula: sequence deviation * (normalized ERP / ERP edits), averaged over routes
metric.direction: lower is better; 0 is a perfect match
metric.numpy_note: score.py pins numpy 1.20.1, which does not install on Python 3.12; ran on numpy 2.5.4

invalid_handling: invalid answers are omitted from the proposal file, so official evaluate() assigns the challenge's invalid-sequence score

prompts.neighbours: 5 nearest other locations by supplied travel time from the stop, ties by ID, seconds rounded
